title: cli: os migrate plan does not list the permission-set grant's package-less guard that os migrate apply builds
body:
domain:server#6 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAnTcb4cZVkPdhkPicW

Filing gate: ① product defect with a named producer (should-fix 4 of contract review 6788505916, carried open by delta record 6801350886 on PR #32357 for #32164; the seat files it).
reach: named producer. `os migrate apply` builds `uniq_sys_user_permission_set_packageless` (metadata-protocol `migrations/user-permission-set-packageless-index.ts`, wired by PR #32357), but `os migrate plan` lists no step for it. The plan an operator reads before applying is silent about a DDL the apply then runs.

## Expected

`os migrate plan` lists the guard step it would build, as it lists the other runtime-owned indexes. Follow the precedent of the activation-ledger guard if the plan already lists that one. After PR #32357 the build reads the catalog first, so `apply` over a standing guard sends nothing; the plan should say the same (present → no step).

## Business reason

Who: operators upgrading with `os migrate plan` then `apply`. Without it, the plan under-reports the apply's DDL on the permission-set grant table.

## Reader

The `domain:server` seat that claims it after triage, once PR #32357 has landed.

## Duplicate check

Written from the record's finding. No separate search: the guard is new in PR #32357, so no older card can name it.
